summary: cisco.nxos removed the nxos_bgp, nxos_bgp_af, nxos_bgp_neighbor and nxos_bgp_neighbor_af modules.
questions: nxos_bgp is gone, what should I use?
How do I configure BGP neighbors on NX-OS now?

answer_card.title: cisco.nxos BGP modules removed
answer_card.answer_md: Removed: `nxos_bgp`, `nxos_bgp_af`, `nxos_bgp_neighbor`, `nxos_bgp_neighbor_af`. Use the resource modules **`cisco.nxos.nxos_bgp_global`**, `nxos_bgp_address_family` and `nxos_bgp_neighbor_address_family`.
